name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 02
name.en: 30MM Option parts set ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 02

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、印象的なパイルバンカーを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場！
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," a group of weapons including an impressive pile bunker is now available as an optional parts set!

description.ja: • 武器の内容は「RF-025 SCUDDER」「PB-033M ASHMEAD」「BML-G1/P32DUO-03」「SONGBIRDS」。
description.en: • Weapons include "RF-025 SCUDDER ", " PB-033M ASHMEAD ", " BML-G1/P32DUO-03 ", and " SONGBIRDS".

description.ja: • 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
description.en: • Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.

description.ja: • 左手武器「PB-033M ASHMEAD」には射出状態を再現可能な差し替えパーツが付属。
description.en: • The left hand weapon "PB-033M ASHMEAD" comes with replacement parts that can reproduce the ejection state.
